platforms.notes: No native virtual camera exists yet, so nothing has been tested.
platforms.reproSteps: 1) Install AI Virtual Camera and start a session. 2) Open the app's camera settings and look for 'AI Virtual Camera'. 3) Select it and confirm the live preview shows the animated avatar. 4) Run a real test call or preview for 15 minutes, watching for freezes or dropped frames. 5) Switch to a physical camera and back; unplug and replug. 6) Record versions, Windows build and result here.
